fomoCatalog.paceRule: Meme means category Memes or launchpad Pump.fun, Four.meme, Flap, StonkFun, pons, LaunchLab, Nad.Fun, or LONG. Meteora Alpha Vault is excluded. A pace spike needs liquidity of at least $50,000 and either 5-minute volume of at least $2,000 and at least 8x the token's own average 5-minute volume, or 1-hour volume of at least $8,000 and at least 3.5x its average hour. A collapsed print where 5-minute, 1-hour, and 24-hour volume match is left off.
